title: COMMONKIT: set a member's roles in Makerlab commons
description: Makerlab DAO only. Replaces one member's roles (steward, verifier, trainer, council) in commons.makerlab, which pushes them to every active asset. Gas is 60 Tgas = 10 + 25 per active asset for the 2 active Makerlab assets; re-author the template if that count changes.

fields.name: roles
fields.label: Roles (JSON array)
fields.help: e.g. ["steward","trainer"]; any of steward, verifier, trainer, council.
